decision_note: The five-replicate target and the plan to run r1-r2 first, followed by r3-r5, were discussed before the formal r1-r2 results were observed.

resource_change.justification: Completed r1-r2 author jobs used 2.3-3.5 GiB MaxRSS and averaged less than one CPU; the smaller request is nonbinding and improves scheduler placement.
